name: David Aalbers
story: David Aalbers is a software developer, architect and technical lead whose work has included geospatial products. After more than a decade in the ArcGIS ecosystem, he described moving into a new development role in December 2024. His career therefore connects specialist GIS application development with broader software engineering.
David Aalbers joined GBS in 2011 and contributed to work for its customers.
GBS’s company history describes Lisa Read’s work on development and processes, Shane Pienaar’s technical direction, and David Aalbers and Heath Rongo joining in 2011 and 2012.
